findings.message: dropRequestedOnShow is one flag not scoped to the toggle that set it. After toggle A succeeds (flag true, reload A in flight, toggling already null at L205), a second click starts toggle B; reload A then reaches show and clears the requested state of B while PUT B is in flight, so the checkbox visibly reverts, contrary to plan L75. A third click between PUT B resolving and reload B showing reads the stale todo.done and re-sends the value of B instead of reversing it. The end state is consistent with what was sent and the window is two round-trips, so in the normal flow this is a transient flicker.
findings.suggestion: Set dropRequestedOnShow.current to false at the start of toggle, or tag requested with a toggle sequence number compared in show, and add a tests-node case: a second click before the re-query keeps the requested state until its own re-query.
